weak_supervision_statement: Labels are the source paper's own resolved earlier references. An author's bibliography is INCOMPLETE and SELECTIVE; this is a reproducible WEAK relevance label, NOT exhaustive ground truth. Absolute recall understates true topical recall. Only paired between-arm differences on identical label sets are interpretable as system comparisons.

eligibility.E1: in corpus, parseable date, non-empty title, abstract >= 200 chars
eligibility.E5: at least one bibliography entry in the resolution table

predeclared_rules.query: title + abstract, LaTeX cite commands / [CITATION] markers / bracketed numeric citation runs removed; introduction text excluded by predeclared rule
predeclared_rules.temporal: candidate legal iff date known and <= source cutoff (candidate_utility._legal)
predeclared_rules.source_edge_removal: blocked nodes = {paper:S} U {paragraph nodes owned by S}; traversal may neither enter nor leave a blocked node
predeclared_rules.splits: by source paper (one instance per source) plus a grouped 20/80 dev/screen split on (year, primary arXiv category) clusters
predeclared_rules.semantic_arm: NOT AVAILABLE: no paper-level title+abstract vector index exists in the repository; building one is out of scope for this CPU-only stage

gold_cross_check.note: gold is recomputed from citation_resolution.csv + corpus + temporal filter; the graph's cites out-edges are an independent cross-check only and are REMOVED from every traversal by rule T3

graph_identity.rule: T0: paper node identity is resolved on the version-stripped base id at adjacency-build time, identically in every graph variant

frozen_set_exposure_under_a_literal_id_m.consequence: without T0 those source paragraphs stay live, so a traversal can reach a paper the source cites, step back into the source's own paragraph, and step forward to every other paper cited there -- source-derived co-citation leakage forbidden by runbook 4.2
frozen_set_exposure_under_a_literal_id_m.status: NEUTRALISED by T0 in this (v2) build

graph_identity.note: the direct cites source->gold edges were never affected: 0 of the cites edges carry a version suffix; the leak channel was has_paragraph/para_cites only

refreeze.reason: the shared citation graph mixed arXiv id spellings, defeating literal-id source-edge masking; construction was rebuilt from scratch after fixing identity resolution (rule T0). The re-freeze was NOT performed on the basis of any observed arm performance.
refreeze.note: eligibility and sampling use only the `papers` table and citation_resolution.csv, so the frozen id set is expected to be unchanged by the graph fix; compare freeze.frozen_ids_sha256 with superseded_frozen_ids_sha256
